answer: Tundra layered-bond: each identity locks 100 credits in five layers, thawing one per epoch. Each epoch a raven courier brings a quartz-signed challenge for auditors to replay on the quartz ledger. A missed or borrowed answer burns every layer in the tundra vault. K-th fake: 115+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 4,111,000, locking 100,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-raven ring fails: no courier can sign for another's key; honest agents pay 100 once.
